name: Play-Action Deep Cross
situation: 1st & 10, own 30, after a big slant-flat gain

summary.motive: Exploit the slant-flat success by freezing the second-level defenders with run action and shooting the vacated middle.
summary.whyItWorks: Two simultaneous fakes force both linebackers into run fits; the twenty-yard crosser attacks the exact grass they leave when the pass reveals itself.
summary.failureMode: Linebackers play run-pass split discipline and keep their eyes on the receivers, staying attached to the crosser.

beats.title: 1. The Bite
beats.text: The fullback's dive and the halfback's sweep path present two run threats at once. The Mike triggers downhill and the free safety rocks up — the whole shell tilts to the run.

beats.title: 2. The Ball Comes Out
beats.text: The quarterback pulls the ball from the mesh and resets to his drop while the linebackers are still in their run fits with their backs to the routes.

beats.title: 3. The Crosser Departs
beats.text: X breaks inside at twenty yards exactly as the Mike begins his recovery scramble. The post behind him pins both deep-half defenders.

beats.title: 4. Behind the Frozen Hooks
beats.text: The crosser runs free through the space the linebackers occupied during the bite. The throw arrives where only the recovering free safety can contest it.

relations.tell: The fullback crosses the line of scrimmage carrying the fake — on the real slant-flat he never leaves the pocket.
